integrity: Exact finite-field enumeration and algebraic proof; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Specifically the characteristic-five specialization; reduced singular scheme only, not full Jacobian scheme; earlier 1984 lecture lacks a verified day of first public distribution. The 2015 source is a day-dated preprint on the motivating Coxeter object. Originality outside inspected literature remains open.
title: The characteristic-five icosahedral mirrors are all secants of a finite conic
